lines.cap: Every chai stall has a man who knows everything.
lines.say: Every chai stall has a man who knows everything.

lines.cap: Petrol prices? Simple. I'll fix it in one week.

lines.cap: Cricket team? Wrong captain. I said it in 2011.
lines.say: Cricket team? Wrong captain. I said it in 2011.

lines.cap: Then, his phone rings. It's his wife.
lines.say: Then, his phone rings. It's his wife.

lines.cap: Where is the milk? I said one hour ago.

lines.cap: The economy can wait. The milk cannot.

lines.bubble: THE ECONOMY CAN WAIT. THE MILK CANNOT. 🏃

lines.cap: He runs. Leaving a stall full of unsolved problems.
lines.say: He runs. Leaving a stall full of unsolved problems.

lines.cap: Tag the chai uncle you know. Every chai stall has a man who knows everything.
